QuestInfo.name: A Chance to Redeem Yourself
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart tells you that one of the former empress's keepsakes was spotted in the #b#eGusty Peak#n#k area. Since the area is dangerous, he wants you to find it with Irena's assistance, but you don't need her. You can head to the Gusty Peak at North Rocky Mountain alone.
QuestInfo.2: You headed out alone, eliminated the monsters and returned, but Neinheart was NOT HAPPY. Sheesh.
QuestInfo.summary: You must eliminate the Ghost Stump in Gusty Peak and find the former empress's keepsakes.

0.0: Mihile, I need you in Perion. I've received word that one of Aria's lost treasures is in the North Rocky Mountain. One of the monsters should lead you there.

0.msg: This is a dangerous mission to take on by yourself. Take Irena with you.

1.msg: #b(I don't need her help. I don't need anyone's help. I have to do this on my own...)#k

no.0: Retrieving Aria's keepsake is of utmost importance. And I do not appreciate your back-talk.

0.1: Go to the #e#bGusty Peak#k#n near Perion and battle the Ghost Stumps.

1.0: I told you to take Irena, yet she tells me you didn't even contact her! How can you call yourself a knight when you ignore my orders?!\r\n#L0##bI defeated the monsters and retrieved Empress Aria's keepsake all on my own! I didn't need anyone to hold my hand!#l\n#k
1.1: I will not permit that kind of reckless nonsense among my knights. When I give you an order, you execute it to the letter.\r\n#L0##bI-I was just trying to give my all! I wanted to show you I could do it... #l\n#k
1.2: I do not need you to prove your strength in some errant playground squabble, Mihile. I need you to be a leader. And leaders do not act on their own behalf.
